india_alignment.label: Leaning West
india_alignment.interpretation: India is strategically non-aligned but under increasing pressure to choose. Current tilt: moderate Western lean while maintaining Russian energy ties.
india_alignment.punjab_impact: Non-alignment keeps multiple diaspora corridors open. A forced choice would close either Five Eyes (Canada/UK/Australia) or Russia/Gulf channels.

UN_SC.name: UN Security Council
UN_SC.note: India has no veto. Permanent members control any binding resolution on South Asia.
UN_SC.punjab_relevance: Any India-Pakistan conflict requires UNSC resolution. India has no veto. China (Pakistan ally) and USA (India partner) have veto. Punjab is the battlefield.

BRICS.name: BRICS+
BRICS.note: India joined BRICS 2009. Tension: India-China border dispute while in same bloc.
BRICS.punjab_relevance: BRICS de-dollarisation push affects remittance corridors. Russia-India oil trade boosts India economy but angers West — affects visa/diaspora access.

SCO.name: Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
SCO.note: India and Pakistan are both SCO members since 2017. China leads de facto.
SCO.punjab_relevance: SCO frames India-Pakistan dialogue through Chinese-led structure. Punjab border directly affected. Sikh pilgrimage to Pakistan (Nankana Sahib, Panja Sahib) dependent on India-Pakistan SCO cooperation.

G20.name: G20
G20.note: India held G20 presidency 2023. Food security and fertiliser supply chain are G20 agenda items.
G20.punjab_relevance: G20 food security resolutions directly affect global wheat/fertiliser prices. Punjab agriculture dependent on international price signals set here.

G7.name: G7
G7.note: G7 controls global financial sanctions (SWIFT), technology export controls, and sets norms India must navigate.
G7.punjab_relevance: G7 sanctions on Russia restrict India trade. Canada-India tension (Sikh diaspora nexus) directly affects Punjab NRI remittances and immigration. UK visa policy affects Doaba corridor.

QUAD.name: Quadrilateral Security Dialogue
QUAD.note: QUAD is anti-China in practice. India participates but hedges — simultaneously in SCO and BRICS with China.
QUAD.punjab_relevance: If QUAD becomes formal alliance, India must take a side. China-India tension escalates. Punjab border posture affected.

CPEC.name: China-Pakistan Economic Corridor
CPEC.status: Phase II under negotiation (ML-1 railway, Gwadar port expansion)
CPEC.note: CPEC passes through Pakistan-administered Kashmir — India rejects it as sovereignty violation.
CPEC.punjab_relevance: CPEC completion changes Central Asian trade routes. Pakistan becomes China transit hub. India-Pakistan trade economics shift. Long-term: Wagah crossing importance changes.

INSTC.name: International North-South Transport Corridor
INSTC.note: India alternative to CPEC. Bypasses Pakistan entirely.
INSTC.punjab_relevance: INSTC success reduces India dependence on Pakistan transit. Punjab agricultural exports could reach Central Asia via this corridor. Counter to CPEC.

next_yalta_scenarios.title: Indus Waters Treaty Collapses
next_yalta_scenarios.trigger: India suspends Indus Waters Treaty post-attack. Pakistan counter-escalates.
next_yalta_scenarios.punjab_impact: CRITICAL — Punjab rivers are the Indus tributaries. Ravi, Beas, Sutlej. Agricultural water access existential.
next_yalta_scenarios.sikh_representation: None at negotiating table. Punjab farmers have no direct voice.
next_yalta_scenarios.signal_to_watch: India-Pakistan IWT meetings, World Bank arbitration filings

next_yalta_scenarios.title: Permanent Canada-India Diplomatic Break
next_yalta_scenarios.trigger: Further killings on Canadian soil attributed to India. Five Eyes formally sanction India.
next_yalta_scenarios.punjab_impact: HIGH — 770,000 Punjabis in Canada. Remittance corridor ($3B+/year) at risk. Doaba region most affected.
next_yalta_scenarios.sikh_representation: Sikh MPs in Canada have voice but are caught between two governments. No institutional Panthic representation.
next_yalta_scenarios.signal_to_watch: RCMP charges against Indian operatives, Canadian visa processing for Indians

next_yalta_scenarios.title: China-India LAC Conflict Escalates
next_yalta_scenarios.trigger: Galwan-style incident escalates. China blockades Ladakh. Two-front war scenario.
next_yalta_scenarios.punjab_impact: HIGH — Punjab is Indian Army's primary mobilisation base. Amritsar, Jalandhar are logistics hubs. Civilian economy disrupted.
next_yalta_scenarios.sikh_representation: Sikh soldiers disproportionate in Indian Army but zero political decision-making role.
next_yalta_scenarios.signal_to_watch: LAC troop movements, China-Pakistan coordination signals, US arms sales to India

next_yalta_scenarios.title: Second Global Food Crisis (Ukraine + El Niño)
next_yalta_scenarios.trigger: Ukraine war continues. El Niño cuts Asian monsoon. Global wheat stocks at record low.
next_yalta_scenarios.punjab_impact: EXTREME — Punjab produces 15% of India wheat, 25% of rice. Export bans keep local prices low but farmers lose income. Or: global demand spikes income but inflation hurts poor.
next_yalta_scenarios.sikh_representation: Punjab farmers have no G20 voice. Decisions made in Washington, Brussels, New Delhi.
next_yalta_scenarios.signal_to_watch: USDA world supply reports, India Food Corporation stock levels, El Niño forecasts

next_yalta_scenarios.title: World Splits into Two Hard Blocs (New Cold War)
next_yalta_scenarios.trigger: USA-China tech war becomes comprehensive. SWIFT split. Two payment systems. India must choose.
next_yalta_scenarios.punjab_impact: SYSTEMIC — If India joins US bloc: CAD/GBP diaspora corridors safe, Russia oil banned, fertiliser prices spike. If India joins China bloc: diaspora countries sanction India, Sikh NRI status threatened.
next_yalta_scenarios.sikh_representation: Sikh community is split across both potential blocs (majority in Five Eyes countries). No unified position. Will be torn.
next_yalta_scenarios.signal_to_watch: India UN votes, India joining CBDC systems, semiconductor import sources, G20 communiqué language

yalta_pattern_history.decision: Colonial order preserved. Indian demands for self-rule ignored. Gandhi's non-cooperation movement launched.
yalta_pattern_history.punjab_impact: Jallianwala Bagh massacre (April 1919) — 379+ killed. British retain Punjab. No international accountability.
yalta_pattern_history.pattern: Major powers in transition → colonial subjects ignored → violence in Punjab

yalta_pattern_history.decision: Post-war world divided. British Empire fate discussed. Indian independence timeline left vague.
yalta_pattern_history.punjab_impact: Partition 1947 decided by British withdrawal timeline set here. Punjab divided, 1-2 million killed.
yalta_pattern_history.pattern: Major powers redraw maps → Punjab divided → catastrophic human cost

yalta_pattern_history.decision: US sends USS Enterprise to Bay of Bengal. USSR counters. India wins but under superpower shadow.
yalta_pattern_history.punjab_impact: War fought partly on Punjab front. Post-war: Simla Agreement locks Kashmir dispute.
yalta_pattern_history.pattern: Superpower proxy positioning → Punjab is frontline → outcomes set by external power balance

yalta_pattern_history.decision: No international intervention. UK Special Air Service advisors reportedly involved in planning.
yalta_pattern_history.punjab_impact: Sri Darbar Sahib desecrated. 492+ killed (official), thousands more (estimated). Sikh diaspora permanently radicalized.
yalta_pattern_history.pattern: India acts in Punjab → world silent → Sikh community bears consequence alone

yalta_pattern_history.event: Canada-India diplomatic crisis (Hardeep Singh Nijjar killing)
yalta_pattern_history.decision: Five Eyes countries vs India standoff. India expelled diplomats. No international legal resolution.
yalta_pattern_history.punjab_impact: Sikh diaspora Canada immigration threatened. Punjab NRI remittances at risk. Sikh political advocates branded as security threats.
yalta_pattern_history.pattern: Sikh diaspora political activity → state response → Punjab's external economic lifeline threatened

canada.power_level: SIGNIFICANT — NDP kingmaker in minority government situations
canada.risk: India-Canada tensions making Sikh MPs targets of Indian intelligence allegations

uk.power_level: MODERATE — Growing but no cabinet-level representation
uk.risk: Post-Brexit immigration tightening affects new Punjabi migrants

notable: Raja Krishnamoorthi (Indian-American, Hindu — Sikh allies in Congress)
usa.power_level: LOW — No Sikh Congress members. Community politically fragmented.
usa.risk: H-1B policy affects Punjabi tech workers

india_punjab.note: Punjab has elected government but fiscal crisis limits autonomy. Delhi-center controls security.
india_punjab.power_level: LIMITED — State government under central financial pressure

sikh_political_power.note: SGPC is largest Sikh institution. ~₹900 Cr annual budget. Manages 85 historic Gurdwaras.

russia_sanctions.imposed_by: USA, EU, UK, Canada, Australia, Japan
russia_sanctions.india_impact: India buying Russian oil at discount. G7 critical but not sanctioning India (yet).
russia_sanctions.punjab_impact: Russian fertiliser (potash, urea) supply disrupted. Global prices spike → Punjab farm input costs rise.

iran_sanctions.india_impact: India reduced Iran oil imports under US pressure. Chabahar port granted waiver.
iran_sanctions.punjab_impact: Chabahar waiver crucial for India-Central Asia corridor that bypasses Pakistan.

china_tech_controls.india_impact: India benefits from semiconductor supply chain diversification (China+1 strategy).
china_tech_controls.punjab_impact: Indirect: if India becomes major tech manufacturing hub, Punjab labor migration patterns shift.

canada_india_tension.india_impact: Visa processing slowed. Intelligence sharing suspended. Trade talks paused.
canada_india_tension.punjab_impact: HIGH — Doaba remittance corridor threatened. Student visa pipeline disrupted.

India.trend: diversifying away from Russia post-Ukraine sanctions

sipri_arms.note: India is world's largest arms importer. Dependency on Russia creates G7 tension.
sipri_arms.punjab_relevance: India-Pakistan military balance determined by these supply chains. Punjab is the primary land frontier.
